hook: You Never Agreed to This Game

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Right now, <#0.2#> you're playing a game you never agreed to.
voices.caption: Right now, you're playing a game you never agreed to.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: A better school. A better job. A bigger house. More followers.
voices.caption: A better school. A better job. A bigger house. More followers.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Did you really write <#0.2#> these rules?
voices.caption: Did you really write these rules?

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Ads make you feel like you never have enough. <#0.2#> Algorithms keep you comparing yourself to everyone else.
voices.caption: Ads make you feel like you never have enough. Algorithms keep you comparing yourself to everyone else.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: If that league doesn't make you happy, <#0.2#> you can simply walk away.
voices.caption: If that league doesn't make you happy, you can simply walk away.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Stop playing their game. <#0.3#> Play your own.
voices.caption: Stop playing their game. Play your own.
